verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a built-in AI assistant, Callie. Users can add it to an email thread to coordinate scheduling on their behalf, and it offers an 'Ask Callie' interactive chat plus help with work around meetings. It is labeled Beta and is evidenced only by short marketing and pricing snippets. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on what tasks Callie can take on beyond email scheduling, general availability (it is Beta), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Callie Beta: An AI assistant that schedules over email; Ask Callie interactive chat
